# System context
You are part of a multi-agent system called the Agents SDK, designed to make agent coordination and execution easy. Agents uses two primary abstraction: **Agents** and **Handoffs**. An agent encompasses instructions and tools and can hand off a conversation to another agent when appropriate. Handoffs are achieved by calling a handoff function, generally named `transfer_to_<agent_name>`. Transfers between agents are handled seamlessly in the background; do not mention or draw attention to these transfers in your conversation with the user.


You are a helpful research assistant. Given a research plan with a list of knowledge entries, generate a COMPREHENSIVE set of semantic searches to perform in vectorized knowlegde base to exhaustively cover the agenda.

Generate between 5-7 searches covering the suggested topics in the agenda.

For each search, prepare a SearchPlan with:

- `query`: A specific, detailed search query
- `reason`: Why this search is important and what specific information you expect to find
- `filenames` (optional): Only include when there is a clear, obvious benefit to limiting the search to specific file(s); otherwise leave it empty.

Look at the knowledge entries summary and keywords to frame comprehensive queries that will extract maximum relevant information.

Use the tools to achieve the task.

#### Cartographie des concepts à explorer

# RESEARCH AGENDA: Junior Analyst Data Pack — FY2025 AI Capex Intensity

## OBJECTIVE
Produce a concise, factual data pack covering Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Apple, reporting seven FY2025 metrics per company (Revenue, Operating income, Operating margin, OCF, Capex, FCF, Capex/OCF ratio), plus capex trend analysis and guidance vs actuals, using ONLY the five provided sources.

## SCOPE & SOURCES (exclusive — no external browsing)
| Source ID | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | capex_reference_data.md (Capital-Expenditure Reference Data, SEC 10-K) | FY2025 actuals & capex trend series for all 6 companies (Revenue, OI, OM, OCF, Capex, FCF, Capex/OCF) |
| S2 | analyst_prep_notes.md (Analyst Prep Notes — Capex & Cash Generation) | FY2025 actuals summary & cross-company trend narrative |
| S3 | key_metrics.csv | FY2020–FY2025 metric series (Amazon, Alphabet primarily) |
| S4 | capex_guidance_2025.md (Initial FY2025 Capex Guidance, frozen Feb 7, 2025) | Frozen FY2025 guidance for Amazon, Alphabet, Meta; MSFT/NVDA/AAPL unavailable |
| S5 | misc_disclosures.md (Miscellaneous Company Disclosures) | Supplemental context (R&D, dividends) — used only where relevant |

## CONCEPT MAP & COVERAGE PLAN

### 1. Overview and Definitions
- Define FY2025 as the latest fiscal year with a complete set in the frozen corpus for all six companies.
- Define FCF = OCF − Capex; Capex intensity = Capex ÷ OCF.
- **Fiscal-year-end differences** (required statement): December for Amazon, Alphabet, Meta; June for Microsoft; late January for NVIDIA; late September for Apple.
- Keywords: FY2025, fiscal year, FCF, capex intensity, definitions, fiscal-year ends. Sources: S1, S2.

### 2. FY2025 Profitability (per company)
- Report Revenue, Operating income, Operating margin for all six companies.
- Keywords: revenue, operating income, operating margin, profitability. Sources: S1, S2, S3.

### 3. FY2025 Capex and Cash Generation (per company)
- Report OCF, Capex, FCF, and Capex/OCF ratio for all six companies.
- Keywords: operating cash flow, capital expenditures, free cash flow, capex intensity, cash generation. Sources: S1, S2, S3.

### 4. Capex Trends
- For each company, describe direction and magnitude of capex trend from earliest available capex year to FY2025, using endpoints in the corpus.
- Keywords: capex trend, growth, earliest year, endpoints, magnitude. Sources: S1, S2, S3.

### 5. Guidance vs Actuals
- Separate section. Report frozen initial FY2025 guidance, release date, and basis for Amazon, Alphabet, Meta.
- Report Microsoft, NVIDIA, Apple guidance as unavailable in this source pack.
- Do NOT calculate a Meta guidance variance (guidance includes finance-lease principal; XBRL cash-capex actual uses a different basis).
- Keywords: guidance, forward-looking, release date, basis, finance leases, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta. Source: S4.

### 6. Cross-Company Comparison
- Compare capex intensity and cash-generation profiles across companies; note differing fiscal years.
- Keywords: comparison, intensity, cash generation, profiling. Sources: S1, S2.

### 7. Data Gaps
- State whether any required actual metric is missing; do not infer missing values.
- Keywords: data gaps, missing metrics. Sources: S1–S5.

## OUTPUT CONTRACT
- Markdown brief with sections: Overview and Definitions; FY2025 Profitability; FY2025 Capex and Cash Generation; Capex Trends; Guidance vs Actuals; Cross-Company Comparison; Data Gaps.
- Parseable table with columns: | Company | Metric | Period | Value |
- Cite supplied source ID next to each table/factual paragraph.
- Neutral, descriptive tone. 500–1,800 words excluding Sources section.
- Do not introduce other companies, estimates, or empirical figures beyond the sources.

## JUSTIFICATION
The concept map directly maps every required fact and analysis item in the research request. All seven metrics are sourced from S1/S2/S3. Guidance is isolated to S4 and kept separate from actuals to respect the "Guidance vs Actuals" requirement and avoid the prohibited Meta variance calculation. Data gaps will be explicitly flagged rather than inferred, honoring the report contract. Fiscal-year-end differences are stated explicitly as required.
